name: hermes
description: Hermes provider module: the vendored agent-routing / capability-registry / model-tiering module's local agent-service inference endpoint, speaking the Ollama-compatible /api/chat wire shape, with the frozen hermes -> hermes/ollama fallback.

features.desc: Ollama-compatible /api/chat chat (stream: false, message.content, prompt_eval_count/eval_count) for the local hermes3 endpoint.
The local agent-service endpoint requires no API key (requires_key=false).
The EPIC #253 frozen map hermes -> hermes/ollama makes the keyless local Ollama hop its terminal fallback.

provenance.note: Gateway-owned module-catalog entry (issue #349) for the registered `hermes` provider adapter. Pattern/READY only; the Ollama-compatible wire shape and the agent -> model/provider routing vocabulary were re-implemented for this repo's Python substrate, no source file was copied.
